subject: science
concept: Understanding that mixing substances can create a mixture that can often be separated again
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Physical Science Disciplinary Core Ideas (Structure and Properties of Matter) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student mixes sand and water, then separates them again using a simple filtering method
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a mixture to a possible method of separating it
exercise.abstract: Student predicts whether a described mixture could be separated and how

misconception_flags: confuses a mixture (still separable) with a chemical reaction that created a new substance

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
